findings.description: KilimAuction.claimSymbols(uint256,address) (src/KilimAuction.sol#126-156) has external calls inside a loop: collection.mintSymbols(to,msg.sender,firstIds[i],counts[i]) (src/KilimAuction.sol#153)

ERC20EnglishAuction.settle() (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#112-119) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < endsAt (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#115)

ERC20EnglishAuction._handleBid(uint256) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#142-170) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- settled || block.timestamp < startsAt || (started && block.timestamp >= endsAt) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#146)
	- extended > endsAt (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#168)

ERC20EnglishAuction.constructor(ERC20EnglishAuction.AuctionConfig) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#68-91) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- config.paymentToken.code.length == 0 || config.treasury == address(0) || config.treasury == address(this) || config.startsAt <= block.timestamp || config.duration == 0 || config.duration > 2592000 || config.extensionWindow == 0 || config.extensionWindow > config.duration || config.incrementBps == 0 || config.incrementBps > MAX_BPS (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#70-74)
